title: Photograph card — unlisted class group
summary: The catalogue card for the photograph, not the photograph. The image itself is NEEDS COMMISSION and stays that way: an image_placeholder block sits in a plausible archival mount and says so. The card's own content is real prototype content, and it is the one document that grants knowledge — harmlessly, since a player holding the item almost certainly has the fact.

blocks.text: Three rows. Back row standing, on a bench. No names to the reverse. Mount trimmed on one edge, not squarely.
not on the 1998 list. not on the typed list. not on the pencil corrections. — I.
